title: The Preschool SLP: KellyVessSLP - Videos
description:
✅Join SIS and have your activities 100% done-for-you every week: planned, prepped, and ready to go at https://www.kellyvess.com/sls
🧪The Preschool SLP is dedicated to creating interventions that make a difference for children with special needs. 
💪🏽Only powerful, evidence-based strategies that truly create change are covered in this channel. 
🌈Have a life-long impact on children with special needs by adding these powerful strategies to your interventions when neuroplasticity is at its height. 
💝Thank you for joining at today's drawing board to create better tomorrows,💚Kelly

P.S. Sign up for my weekly free newsletter: https://kellyvess.com
